Selling in the shop: seller guide

How to sell an item by scanning its label with your phone.

Use only your own login. Every sale is recorded with your name. Never give your password to anyone and never use someone else's.

  1. Log in

    Scan any label with the phone camera and open the link. The first time, the login page opens: enter your own username and password and tap Log In. Tick "Remember Me" on your own phone only.

  2. Scan the label

    Point the camera at the QR label and open the link. Check the name, size or colour, price and stock against the item in your hand.

    No camera? Type the code printed under the QR (for example DC-7K4M-9P2X-Q8RT) in the Scan or type a code box.

    A yellow or red message (out of stock, no price, out of date label…) means: do not sell, call the manager.

  3. Choose the quantity

    Choose how many the customer is buying. The list shows the total, for example "2 × ₹1,499.00 = ₹2,998.00".

  4. Choose how the customer paid

    Take the payment first, then tap Cash, UPI, Card or Other. You must always choose one.

  5. Tap Confirm sale

    Tap Confirm sale once and wait for Sold. The stock goes down at once. Then scan the next item.

    "Someone else is selling this item right now"? Wait two seconds and tap again.

  6. Mistake? Undo within 10 minutes

    On the "Sold." page, tap Undo this sale. You can only undo your own sale, once, within 10 minutes. After that the button disappears: ask the manager to void the sale.

  7. My sales

    Tap My sales at the top to see your own sales for Today, Yesterday or the Last 7 days, with the totals for each payment method. At the end of the day, check your cash against it.

  8. Log out

    At the end of your shift, tap Log out (top right), always on a shared shop phone.

When to call the manager

  • The label does not scan, or opens an error page.
  • The price or product on the screen is not the item in your hand.
  • You sold the wrong item or quantity and 10 minutes have passed.
  • You forgot your password (the manager resets it; never borrow a login).
